# Kubusklus

> Kubus Klussenbedrijf (Kubusklus) is a renovation and finishing company in Amsterdam, active since 2006. Services include facades, roughcast, plastering, decorative plaster, sanding, painting, tiling, parquet and partition walls in Amsterdam and the Randstad. Contact: info@kubusklus.nl, +31 6 44 33 11 91. Address: Overschiestraat 170-A28, 1062 XK Amsterdam.

The site is bilingual: Dutch (/nl, default) and English (/en). Quotes are requested through the online form on the quote page.

## Pages (Dutch)

- [Home](https://www.kubusklus.nl/nl): Overview of the company, services, projects and FAQ
- [Diensten](https://www.kubusklus.nl/nl/diensten): All services with descriptions
- [Projecten](https://www.kubusklus.nl/nl/projecten): Photo portfolio of recent projects
- [Werkwijze](https://www.kubusklus.nl/nl/werkwijze): How a job runs, from first contact to delivery
- [Over ons](https://www.kubusklus.nl/nl/over-ons): About the company
- [FAQ](https://www.kubusklus.nl/nl/faq): Frequently asked questions
- [Contact](https://www.kubusklus.nl/nl/contact): Address, phone, e-mail and map
- [Offerte](https://www.kubusklus.nl/nl/offerte): Free quote request form
